title: tunnelmind:code_crew:v1 — AIT constraints
description: Validates the `constraints` object of an ATAP v0.1 AIT declared under the tunnelmind:code_crew:v1 profile. The canonical-byte serialization of `constraints` MUST NOT exceed 4096 bytes (ATAP v0.1 §6.2).

autonomy_class.description: supervised: the owner approves every change before merge. gated: the crew runs unattended and stops at declared gates (merge, deploy) for an owner approval. autonomous: the crew may merge and deploy without an approval event.

allowed_repos.description: Repositories the crew may commit to, as owner/repo. Capped at 50 to respect the 4 KB constraints ceiling.

max_iterations.description: Maximum coder/QA attempts per task before the crew must stop.

models.description: The model each agent role runs on. Keys are agent roles; the human `owner` runs no model.

model.description: Model identifier, e.g. claude-opus-5-5. No `@` or spaces, so it cannot carry an email address or free text.
